name: Landslide is immune to his own Landslide channel, so it summons no Shardlings and drops the group stun (#7004)
contract: In the supplied Spell.dbc, Landslide 21808 has spell mechanic Stun (12) and is an 8 s self-channel: effect 0
applies a periodic trigger on the caster that casts Summon Theradrim Shardling 21809 (summons 11783) every
2 s, and effect 1 stuns enemies within 100 yards. Ascension's combat logs show Landslide's self-hit IMMUNE,
the players' stun ending after about 0.09 s and no Shardlings. So after the cast and a full 2.5 s periodic
window, Landslide carries no 21808 aura and is no longer channeling, the nearby player is not stunned and no
Shardling exists. Without the immunity the channel holds for 8 s, the player stays stunned and the first
Shardling appears at 2 s. The open-world fixture keeps Maraudon's own Landslide spawn out of the measurement.

steps.label: CONTROL: no Shardling exists before the cast
Wait past the first 2 s Shardling summon
Landslide carries no Landslide channel aura
The player is no longer stunned by Landslide
